intent: Audit my Next.js app's codebase for performance problems, propose fixes, rewrite the slowest components, and write a report of before/after expectations.

spec.goal: Find and fix performance problems in your Next.js app by auditing its codebase, proposing fixes, rewriting the slowest components, and documenting expected before/after results.
spec.deliverable: A performance audit report listing the problems found with proposed fixes and before/after expectations, plus rewritten versions of the slowest components.
constraints: The audit covers the Next.js app's codebase provided by the user.
Only the slowest components are rewritten; other code is left unchanged apart from proposed fixes.
The report states before/after expectations as expected outcomes, not as measured results unless measurements are actually taken.
done_criteria: The report lists the performance problems found in the codebase, each with a proposed fix.
The slowest components are identified and rewritten versions are provided.
The report describes before/after expectations for the identified problems and rewrites.
spec.summary: You want your Next.js codebase audited for performance issues, with fixes proposed, the slowest components rewritten, and a report describing expected before/after results.
